requirements.desc: [P1] task-spec full gate evaluation via same-process RunGateCommand
requirements.note: run-draft-task now instantiates RunGateCommand in-process, executes with phase:"task-spec", and only accepts result === "pass".

requirements.desc: [P2] inject gate FAIL reasons into retry prompt as dedicated section
requirements.note: FAIL feedback is carried via priorReasons into the next buildDraftPrompt call; prompt adds "## Previous attempt failed — reasons" only when FAIL entries exist.

requirements.desc: [P3] flow-impl skill Required Sequence includes addition task branch to call flow run draft-task
requirements.note: SKILL.md adds Required Sequence step 0 for addition-task detection and explicit `sdd-forge flow run draft-task --task-id <id>` execution before continuing.

requirements.desc: [P4] buildDraftPrompt exported with reasons param for unit testing
requirements.note: buildDraftPrompt is now exported with a third `reasons` parameter; new unit tests directly import and verify prompt differences with/without reasons.
Behavior is validated by new unit test in agent-service.test.js confirming non-null resolve via default fallback when no profile mapping exists.
Stub path still passes task context via env and consumes stdout JSON with `{draft: ...}`; existing contract remains, with additional optional env variable added.
simpleGate function and its call site were removed from run-draft-task.js.

requirements.desc: [P8] retry loop bounded by config.flow.retry.max (default 10), escalates with ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
requirements.note: ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED and config/default wiring are present, but loop condition `while (attempts <= retryMax)` with pre-increment allows retryMax+1 attempts.

requirements.desc: [P9] non-zero exit code and ok:false on failure, zero and ok:true only on PASS
requirements.note: On non-PASS terminal state, command throws (expected failure path), and success path returns ok:true; explicit non-zero/ok:false enforcement is delegated to outer CLI envelope code not shown in this diff.

unplanned.change: Prompt format/rules were materially changed (e.g., `# Spec:` and required heading set) beyond the explicit requirements.
Added stderr diagnostic logging for agent container resolution failures/null profile fallback (not explicitly required).
Added `SDD_FORGE_STUB_PROMPT` env propagation to stub path (extra testability hook not explicitly required).
Retry feedback now merges `artifacts.issues` into synthetic FAIL entries (`guardrail_id: "text-check"`), extending beyond strict `artifacts.reasons` forwarding.
Introduced shared PASS draft fixtures and refactored existing tests to consume them (maintenance improvement not a stated requirement).

summary.notes: Implementation aligns with most core requirements (P1–P7), with strongest evidence in run-draft-task wiring, skill sequence update, and added unit tests. Two contract-level points remain only partially evidenced from this diff: strict retry bound semantics (off-by-one style loop) and explicit process exit-code/envelope behavior, which depends on outer CLI handling not included here.
